strength.excerpt: “Declaring support signals compatibility with the free-threaded runtime; it does not mean the extension’s code is thread-safe.”
strength.reason: Clearly separates runtime compatibility from thread safety, a useful distinction for extension authors.

weakness.excerpt: “The way an extension makes that declaration differs between multi-phase and single-phase initialization.”
weakness.reason: Introduces an important distinction but does not explain either method, leaving the central practical detail undeveloped.
